# Agent Decision Request

Use this only when work is blocked on a real product/architecture decision.

## Decision needed

One sentence.

## Why repository evidence cannot resolve it

State the exact ambiguity or conflict.

## Options

Describe viable options neutrally. Do not manufacture alternatives that are
not technically credible.

## Consequences

For each viable option, state user-visible behavior, architecture impact,
migration/compatibility effect, risk, and expected implementation cost.

## Recommendation

A technical recommendation may be offered when evidence clearly supports it,
but identify assumptions and what would change the recommendation.

## Work that can proceed without this decision

State any safely separable work; otherwise say none.
